Your Data Protection Rights (EU/EEA) GDPR UK GDPR

If you are located in the European Union, European Economic Area, or the United Kingdom, you are protected by the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) 2016/679 and have the following rights regarding your personal data.

Lawful Basis for Processing

Contract Performance (Art. 6(1)(b))
Processing your account details, project files, and order data to deliver the Service.
Legitimate Interests (Art. 6(1)(f))
Security monitoring, fraud prevention, and system performance analytics. Our legitimate interests are proportionate and do not override your fundamental rights.
Consent (Art. 6(1)(a))
Where you have opted in to optional features such as AI image enhancement that sends data to third-party AI providers. You may withdraw consent at any time without penalty.
Legal Obligation (Art. 6(1)(c))
Retaining transaction records as required by applicable tax or financial regulations.

Your Rights

Right to Access (Art. 15)

You may request a copy of all personal data we hold about you, together with information about how we use it. We will respond within one calendar month (extendable up to three months for complex requests).

Right to Rectification (Art. 16)

You may request that inaccurate or incomplete personal data is corrected. You can update most personal data directly from your account settings.

Right to Erasure ("Right to Be Forgotten") (Art. 17)

You may request deletion of your personal data where:

  • The data is no longer necessary for the purpose it was collected
  • You withdraw consent and no other lawful basis applies
  • You object to processing and no overriding legitimate interests exist
  • The data has been unlawfully processed

Erasure may not apply where we are required to retain data by law, or where retention is necessary for the establishment, exercise, or defence of legal claims.

Right to Data Portability (Art. 20)

Where processing is based on consent or contract, and is carried out by automated means, you may request your data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format (JSON). You may also request that we transmit it directly to another controller where technically feasible.

Right to Restriction of Processing (Art. 18)

You may request that processing be restricted (i.e., stored but not used) where:

  • You contest the accuracy of data (for the period needed to verify)
  • Processing is unlawful and you prefer restriction over erasure
  • We no longer need the data but you need it for legal claims
  • You have objected to processing and verification is pending

Right to Object (Art. 21)

You may object at any time to processing based on legitimate interests. We will cease processing unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds. You have an absolute right to object to processing for direct marketing purposes.

Rights Related to Automated Decision-Making (Art. 22)

{{APP_NAME}} does not make decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal or similarly significant effects on you without human review.

Data Breach Notification

In the event of a personal data breach that poses a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify the relevant supervisory authority within 72 hours of becoming aware of the breach (Art. 33). Where the breach is likely to result in a high risk to you, we will notify you directly without undue delay (Art. 34).

International Data Transfers (Art. 44-49)

We process data using services in the United States (Railway hosting, Firebase, AI providers). Transfers from the EU/EEA to the USA are conducted on the basis of:

  • Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) — Module 2 (Controller to Processor), as approved by European Commission Decision 2021/914
  • EU-US Data Privacy Framework — where the processor is registered

A list of processors and their transfer mechanisms is available by request.

Data Protection Officer & Supervisory Authority

We have not designated a formal DPO (our processing is not of the type requiring mandatory designation under Art. 37). For data protection queries, contact {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}.

You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. To find your authority, visit the European Data Protection Board.

How to Exercise Your Rights

Submit requests to {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} with subject line "GDPR Rights Request". We may request identity verification before processing your request. We will respond within one calendar month (GDPR Art. 12(3)).

Legal Review Required — Verify: DPO necessity test, SCCs are current Module 2 (2021/914), data retention periods align with actual system retention, legitimate interest assessment (LIA) documented.
